description: This file contains the implementation of the Zipf distribution as part of the Apache Commons Math library. It defines a class that models the probability distribution, including methods for calculating probability, cumulative probability, numerical mean and variance, and related mathematical functions.

classes.name: ZipfDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the Zipf distribution, providing methods to compute probabilities, cumulative probabilities, mean, variance, and distribution support bounds.

methods.name: getNumberOfElements
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements (size of the distribution).

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent parameter of the Zipf distribution.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability mass function for a given integer x.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability mass function for a given integer x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability up to a given integer x.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the numerical mean of the distribution, computing it if necessary.

methods.name: calculateNumericalMean
methods.description: Computes the numerical mean based on the harmonic numbers.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the numerical variance of the distribution, computing it if necessary.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Computes the numerical variance based on the harmonic numbers.

methods.name: generalizedHarmonic
methods.description: Calculates the Nth generalized harmonic number, used in mean and variance calculations.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support (always 1).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (the number of elements).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the distribution support is connected (continuous interval).
